privacy.distinction: Authentication evidence is file SHA/identity provenance. Process credential checks mean UID/GID/capability metadata. Public signer fingerprint, digest values, schema fields, thread/task IDs and owner-selected local paths are not secret credential values. No actual authentication binding was read.

content_safety.inspection: Whole selected raw text and decoded JSON scanned; identified terms and large static strings inspected. Named fixture paths and lexical method/call inventories are references, not included hostile bodies. Node source contains bounded owned process/custody and cryptographic positive/negative validation, not an exploitation workflow. Stock metadata reader templates were read as inert text only.

semantics.limits: Publication review alone; no execution, gate, Root admission or release evidence is created.

method.tools: stock jq/rg/sed/wc/stat/sha256sum; supplied files inert TEXT/JSON only
method.identity_numbers: exact decimal strings; no JS floating-point conversion of source identity9
method.hash_observation: stock full-byte SHA256 at initial and final reads, with pinned named nine-field identity before and after; sha256sum does not expose an opened-fd fstat tuple

resources.resource_note: Explicit conservative content debit covers repeated selected readers/hash passes and reserved plan/artifact reads; implicit IO and aggregate costs are not measured or treated as zero.
